rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (frozen page text layer) sits directly left of or just above it. Booleans take xbox_joins (box immediately left of the printed option; _1/_2/_3 follow the printed option order). Amount rows on Schedules 1-4 pair a peso comb with the 2-slot centavo comb directly right (money_joins). Schedule rows 2 and 3 print no row number, so they take the column header above row 1. The Schedule totals (sched1:txtTotalDue1, sched2/sched3:txtTotalPayment1, sched4:txtTotalRemittance1) print on the same cell as the Item 14/15B/15C/19 keys, so the item keys carry the join. Items 14-19 print on page 1 in 14-slot combs whose last two slots are the centavos (money_joins decimal_html_id), and items 14, 15B, 15C and 19 also in the page 2 schedule total pairs (one key, several cells). The schedule dates print through date_joins; Items 8-9 and the page 2 header print from derived: keys of Form2000Draft::to_print_field_map. Since #113 every value the print map carries has a box or a reviewed not_joined reason.
